title: A2A Liquidity Simulator — Single & Multi-Rail
description: Model intraday cash flow and prefunding requirements across FedNow, RTP, ACH, SEPA Instant, PIX, and UPI. Single and multi-rail simulation with overdraft risk, opportunity cost, and routing waterfall. Client-side, zero PII.
